context.topic: How Indian buyers react to Preserve Archive 001 (discovery, preorder, shipping wait) and whether they repeat for Archive 002
context.time_setting: Scenario beats spanning ~90 days: discovery and preorder, 3-4 week wait, shipping, ~8 weeks later Archive 002 announcement
key_conflicts: prepaying for a product that does not exist vs brand with no history
scarcity-driven collectors vs plant-driven gift buyers
faceless Instagram marketing vs need for trust
marigold bloomed vs dead as driver of repeat
founder 60/40 collector assumption vs survey suggesting gifters dominate
